DATA-22.case: persisted previews rehydrate through the app policy port and LinkPreviewStateHolder for DM and channel consumers; persisted image-extension HTML previews select the card route for primary and secondary media URLs after a cold AppChatContent start; hero and icon bytes reload from persistent storage without live DNS; repeated AppChatContent renderContent calls for the same persisted miss issue a single Room lookup; mounted inline image state is retained across unrelated media-resolution updates

DATA-23.case: cached results remain visible through the state-holder with auto-resolve disabled and unavailable DNS; positive cache retains a bounded 201-preview timeline window under its 50 MiB cost cap; bounded persisted misses are reused, cleared on memory trim, and expire after one minute so external store writes become visible; read failures are not memoized, 201 distinct URL misses remain memoized across repeated timeline reads, and repeated AppChatContent rendering queries a missing preview only once; globally disabled previews skip persistent lookup; cached inline image bytes mount before automatic-fetch gating and without DNS/network work

DATA-24.case: AppChatContent produces a real two-frame GIF, the actual AppMessageContent Compose consumer mounts it, and after trimMemory the mounted viewer's Share control sends the original encoded bytes without refetch

DATA-25.case: positive dimensions use a complete PNG produced by the host-JVM image writer

DATA-26.case: complete PNG/JPEG decode produces a native Bitmap allocation cost consumed by InlineImageCache

DATA-27.case: private redirect target reaches the private-address predicate and listens but must receive zero connections

DATA-28.case: authorized nil-country resolution reaches geocoder; unauthorized resolution does not

DATA-29.case: legitimate-domain decisions use the bundled malware-domain snapshot; loaded and refreshed domains plus queried hosts are normalized case-insensitively; successful network refreshes publish a policy revision so mounted cached images and loaded preview cards are rechecked; warning-state inline images recover after a refreshed policy allows their host

DATA-30.case: explicit schemes are normalized and stop at adjacent angle-bracketed links; bare and www domains use HTTPS; punctuation and unmatched delimiters are bounded; interior apostrophes survive in explicit, bare-domain and opaque URI spans while trailing quote punctuation is trimmed; quoted email local parts including escaped characters and Unicode-adjacent partial ASCII hosts are excluded; hierarchical and opaque non-HTTP URIs, including unknown nested scheme payloads and ftp:files.example.com/did:web:example.com, URL-like email local parts and nested candidates are suppressed without discarding outer query URLs or links after Link:/Visit: labels; unmatched enclosing delimiters end unsupported URI spans before an adjacent HTTPS link; prose See-https:// remains supported while feed-https:// is suppressed; punycode TLDs are complete, malware hosts are checked case-insensitively, and body www links use HTTPS; full NSDataDetector equivalence remains unclaimed and tracked by WP-308 #403

DATA-31.case: original WCMesh.com mention input plus explicit URL mention suppression exercise overlap filtering

DATA-32.case: actual metadata producer scrapes page metadata and passes the hero image through native Bitmap preview processing

DATA-33.case: Robolectric native graphics exercises real bitmap/GIF decoder paths; no physical-device result is claimed

latest_review_repairs.cached_inline_images: Check the current malware policy first, then hydrate an encoded cached image before any DNS safety check; perform URL DNS safety only for an actual network fetch, including when auto-resolve is disabled.
latest_review_repairs.mounted_image_lifecycle: Keep the Compose-mounted image keyed to content and URL rather than the global media-resolution counter, preserving the original decoded handle and share bytes across unrelated rebuilds.
latest_review_repairs.malware_refresh: Publish an observable revision after replacing the malware list; mounted images are hidden until rechecked and each blocked image entry routes through the localized malware warning, including non-first URLs. A Robolectric Compose regression covers a blocked second image.
latest_review_repairs.timeline_miss_cache: Bound negative persisted-lookup memory by both 10,000 entries and an estimated 4 MiB while retaining cache writes as miss invalidations.
latest_review_repairs.url_apostrophes: Allow apostrophes within explicit, bare-domain and URI candidate spans while retaining the existing trailing-quote trimming policy.
latest_review_repairs.unsupported_uri_prefetch: Suppress embedded domains for known and unknown non-HTTP opaque URI schemes while retaining Link:/Visit: prose-label extraction; retain hierarchical-scheme suppression for all `scheme://` URIs.
latest_review_repairs.malware_policy_revision: Include the malware-policy revision in mounted preview-holder identity so cached cards are rechecked; route matching warning-state images through the image check and clear stale warning state after a successful check.
latest_review_repairs.unsupported_uri_boundaries: End unsupported URI spans at unmatched closing delimiters so a separate adjacent web link remains eligible; restrict the See-https prose exception so feed-https stays an opaque scheme.
latest_review_repairs.timeline_positive_cache: Increase the positive-entry cap to 256 without relaxing the existing 50 MiB cost bound; load cached previews for every media URL and verify 201 persisted previews do not trigger reads on a second timeline pass.
latest_review_repairs.secondary_persisted_image_preview: Classify each secondary image-extension URL against its persisted preview before choosing the inline-image route; verify a cached .jpg HTML page displays its saved card with auto-resolve disabled and zero network fetches.
latest_review_repairs.preview_memory_pressure: AppChatContent.trimMemory now clears the positive preview cache and requests persisted-miss/cost clearing under the lookup mutex; verify an externally saved preview becomes visible after trim.
latest_review_repairs.persisted_miss_expiry: Persisted misses expire after 60 seconds using an injectable monotonic clock, allowing previews written by other cache/store clients to become visible.
latest_review_repairs.compose_test_semantics: Replace the unsupported assertDoesNotHaveClickAction helper with a direct SemanticsActions.OnClick absence assertion.
latest_review_repairs.persisted_preview_rehydration: The post-merge candidate run exposed that AppChatContent.renderContent used the memory-only preview lookup; restore the store-backed lookup so saved previews remain available when auto-fetch is disabled.
latest_review_repairs.regression_tests_added: MountedInlineMalwareWarningTest covers a loaded cached card becoming non-clickable after a policy revision and a warning-state image recovering when allowed; LinkUrlExtractionTest covers feed-https rejection, unmatched URI delimiters, and opaque payloads. These cases are pending exact-head hosted execution.
latest_review_repairs.mounted_gif: Exercise the actual Compose AppMessageContent image mount with an injected deterministic safe-malware decision, while the separate mounted malware warning test verifies the real filter; retain the visible GIF and original share bytes through the mounted viewer's Share control across process memory trim. The real-filter adapter test now waits for persisted refresh completion after observing its policy revision, preventing its worker from writing after the test closes storage.
